offering_description.value: Operates dating apps for singles and a friendship app for people seeking platonic connections. It uses member profiles and preferences to suggest connections and offers paid subscriptions and one-time upgrades.

primary_products.value: dating apps; friendship app; premium discovery and profile visibility features

customer_segment.value: B2C: Singles seeking romantic connections and individuals looking to make friends

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring access to premium filters, visibility and match discovery features; transaction or usage fees: One-time purchases of profile boosts and other in-app upgrades

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Uses member profiles and preferences to help individuals discover and message potential dates and friends

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Latin America and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Online dating and platonic friend discovery

distribution_channels.value: online: Mobile app stores and in-app purchases

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Member data, platform moderation and paid subscriptions are subject to privacy, online safety and consumer protection rules.

notes: The current extent of advertising revenue is uncertain.
